name: Samsung Electronics (Korea · memory inside a conglomerate)

data.description: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a global technology leader operating across consumer electronics, information technology and mobile communications, and advanced device solutions sectors. Its extensive product portfolio includes a wide array of home appliances, such as refrigeration units, garment care systems, washing machines, dryers, cooking equipment, dishwashers, vacuum cleaners, and climate control devices like air conditioners and purifiers. The company also delivers cutting-edge personal electronics such as televisions, audio systems, smartphones, tablets, display monitors, smart and LED digital signage, smartwatches, and various accessories, alongside advanced memory storage solutions. Beyond this, Samsung extends its reach into medical technology, software engineering and delivery, and provides semiconductor and display panel manufacturing services. Its comprehensive suite of business services encompasses general logistics, financial offerings, marketing and consulting, technology and cloud support, venture capital investments, enterprise automation platforms, connected solutions, network infrastructure deployment and optimization, and digital advertising services. The firm caters to a diverse range of industries, including retail, hospitality, financial services, transportation, education, government, manufacturing, public safety, and healthcare. Established in 1938, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Suwon-si, South Korea.
